construction: R3=[current,current-prev1,current-prev5]; reversal gives[current,current-prev5,current-prev1]. Fixed invertible coordinate permutation.
PCA_implication: Exact PCA sees the same sample Gram matrix; separate coordinate relabeling cannot remove temporal information. Approximate solver and optimization differences are not evidence that true chronology was lost.
original_gate: R3 superiority over R3-reverse remains a registered requirement but is not an identifiable temporal-order test. Do not call a miss scientific refutation or a numerical win causal evidence.
meaningful_existing_control: R3-shuffle uses independently permuted five-frame windows; it does not reduce to one fixed global coordinate permutation.
